sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Color Merger is a game about merging same colored cubes with an incoming wall of cubes. The game takes place on a simple grid, with cubes of different colors falling from the top. As the cubes fall, you'll need to carefully plan your strategy to merge cubes of the same color. When two or more cubes of the same color collide, they'll merge into a single cube of the same color, earning you points.

The game's core mechanics are incredibly simple, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. However, the game's simplicity belies a depth of strategy and challenge that will keep you engaged for hours on end. As you progress through the game, the speed of the cubes increases, making it increasingly difficult to merge cubes and earn points.

One of the key features of Color Merger is the use of a 'time' system.
